0022600200.text: The Bucks (1-7, 15th in the East and 5th in the Central) host the Celtics (6-2, 2nd in the Atlantic) in Milwaukee's 10th game of the season, with the Bucks on a four-game losing streak. Milwaukee is 1-3 at home and 0-4 on the road, while Boston is 5-0 at home, 1-2 on the road, and riding a one-game winning streak. Boston beat the Bucks 109-102 in Boston on November 4, so Milwaukee trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1, and the Bucks also lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
